messages:
Alex Kim: Opening a quick docs PR to update the model catalog entries for Zephyr-6.8B-quant and Aurora-13B. Need help verifying supported token limits, benchmark numbers, and a small SDK snippet for model-selection. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4821
Mai Patel: Thanks Alex. Which card fields changed? limits? compatibility? examples?
Alex Kim: limits (max_input_tokens, max_total_tokens), compatibility notes for quantized variants, benchmark table (latency/throughput on T4/A10), and a short python/node SDK snippet showing preferred model id + quant flag.
Samir Gupta: On benchmarks — did you run with batching=auto or fixed batch sizes? Need to add a notes column describing batch config and sequence length used. Otherwise numbers won't be reproducible.
Alex Kim: I used batch_size=8 for throughput and batch_size=1 for p50/p95 latency; ctx=2048 for Aurora-13B and ctx=4096 for Zephyr-6.8B. I'll add that to the PR description.
Jordan Lee: Product ask: make sure the catalog explains fallbacks — e.g., when Zephyr-6.8B-quant isn't available we route to Zephyr-6.8B (fp16) and note perf/quality diff. Also call out streaming support status for quantized builds.
Mai Patel: Small correction: current Zephyr card in prod lists max_input_tokens=4096 but our runtime supports 8192 with the new compilation path. We should update that and add a migration note for Dedicated customers (they may need kernel updates).
Alex Kim: Good catch — I'll change to 8192 and add migration note: "Dedicated/private: ensure runtime >= 2.3.1 for 8k support".
docs-bot: CI check passed for docs linting on PR #4821 (:white_check_mark:) — https://ci.redwood/status/4821
Samir Gupta: Also suggest adding a small row to the benchmark table for "cost per 1k tokens" using our cost model so PMs can compare unit economics.
Alex Kim: Adding a cost column. Draft SDK snippet below — please sanity check for style and edge cases.
Alex Kim: ```python
# python SDK snippet for selecting quantized variant
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
model_id = "zephyr-6.8b-quant"
# prefer quantized but fall back to fp16
try:
    resp = client.generate(model=model_id, input="Summarize: ...", quantize=True, max_tokens=256, stream=False)
except Exception as e:
    # fallback to non-quantized variant
    resp = client.generate(model="zephyr-6.8b", input="Summarize: ...", max_tokens=256)
print(resp.text)
```
Alex Kim: And Node snippet: ```js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const model = 'zephyr-6.8b-quant'
client.generate({ model, input: 'Summarize: ...', quantize: true, max_tokens: 256 })
  .catch(() => client.generate({ model: 'zephyr-6.8b', input: 'Summarize: ...', max_tokens: 256 }))
  .then(r => console.log(r.text))
```
Mai Patel: Snippets look fine. Minor nits: mention `quantize` is a client hint — runtime may ignore for incompatible deployments. Add a one-line migration tip for Private: "redeploy agent with quantization libs".
Jordan Lee: Approving content direction. Please add a line to the catalog card: "Recommended for low-cost batch workloads; verify quality regression on your eval set before switching from fp16."
Alex Kim: Will add that and request reviews from @Mai and @Samir. Assigning reviewers in PR. Thanks all :bow: 
Mai Patel: Reviewing after lunch.
Samir Gupta: I'll sanity-check the benchmark table numbers and cost calc tomorrow morning.
Alex Kim: Great — leaving this thread open until reviewers + staging preview look good. Will merge once docs-bot confirms preview build.
